records.issue_text: booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0 fallback could cause incorrect admin/owner checks for non-team bookings if team id 0 is treated as valid
Email sending failure is only console.log'd, silently swallowing errors with no logging/telemetry
records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows the exception and only logs a generic message (no error details/telemetry) while still returning success. This is a specific reliability/observability concern grounded in the diff, not necessarily a functional defect.
